source.title: Zenvocloud: zero-cost first-customer acquisition sprint
source.body:
## Goal
Acquire the first verified paying B2B customer for Zenvocloud/TaskForge, with $0 upfront spend and no invented leads or revenue.

## Current verified baseline (2026-10-12)
- Production homepage and 11 other intended routes return HTTP 200.
- `/api/lead` rejects GET (405) and invalid POST (400); valid submission, storage and notifications not yet verified.
- Upwork freelancer profile is active but positioned primarily around financial planning and unrelated skills; 0 Connects. Do not buy Connects or claim applications were submitted.
- Cloudflare production deployment is successful; do not assume all premium redesign elements are live.

## Work packages (execute, verify, record evidence)
1. Verify the valid lead intake end-to-end using an isolated staging environment and synthetic data; remove test records; verify notifications and avoid any live false leads.
2. Check all visible CTAs and customer paths for broken links, quote request friction, honest service claims, and privacy compliance.
3. Build a concise B2B offer sheet for inventory/CSV cleanup, CRM data quality, and operational automation with truthful sample work and scoped deliverables. Do not invent testimonials or guaranteed outcomes.
4. Prepare free-channel distribution: portfolio pages, relevant communities/directories where business posts are permitted, and compliant, tailored outreach to genuine buyer requests. No mass unsolicited spam.
5. Audit Upwork positioning and draft a factual replacement headline/bio/skills for user confirmation. Do not edit profile without platform-required approval; no paid Connects.
6. Verify merchant checkout and fulfillment independently before accepting payment; keep unverified gates closed.
7. Track weekly metrics: qualified prospects discovered, relevant outreach sent, replies, quotes, verified payments. Report zeros explicitly.

## Acceptance criteria
- Evidence links for each completed action.
- One successful isolated end-to-end synthetic lead test, with cleanup evidence.
- At least one honest, discoverable offer and one verified permitted zero-cost acquisition channel.
- No spending, fabricated customer records, or unauthorized outreach.

Owner workflow: Cavalry team can take work packages through its actual runtime; **this issue is a backlog artifact only and does not prove a Cavalry handoff or background execution**.
